objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed document created, edited, released, distributed, archived, revised, invalidated, reactivated, translated, and displayed in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document and is documented for each released version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document and used in the document lifecycle and workflow.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute in which reader authorizations are assigned via User Group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign the author for the document and workflow.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign additional personal change rights for a document.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reviewers for the document and workflow.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign releasers for the document and workflow.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects email notification when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects distribution of the workflow task when the next version is released.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which validity calculation starts after release.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period defined for a document type and used to calculate the valid-until date.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from valid-from date and period of extended validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration after invalidation before physical deletion, definable for each document type.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Type selected when creating a document and used for structuring, evaluation, templates, numbering, validity periods, and archive duration.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template that can be defined for a document type and selected when creating new objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or new documents generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: External file or document uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: office_format
objs.description: Standard MS Office format used to generate new documents.

objs.name: pdf
objs.description: Converted representation of a saved document displayed on the web.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized and customer-specific document metadata maintained automatically or by the user.

objs.name: category
objs.description: Grouping of attributes and metadata according to their purpose in document properties.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person or system user performing creation, editing, workflow, signature, review, release, acknowledgement, reactivation, and other actions.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for authorization, reader assignment, distribution, archive access, and role availability.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read and change rights assigned to groups of users or persons for each document.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned and completed in workflow-supported processes.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete workflow tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification sent by the system to users involved in workflows, distribution, change proposals, and validity processes.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document and automatically released with the main document.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created and managed for a document without affecting document content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document to be checked before validity expires.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request created to invalidate and archive a released document that has no additional validity.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to re-validate invalidated documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document by assigning User Groups or persons for distribution by email or acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation of acknowledgement requested from persons and documented for a document version.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific area listing relevant documents and information.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report or search available for documents in the system.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which a document can be specified as visible or not.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Master data entity to which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Master data entity to which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Master data entity to which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data to which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated version of a released document checked and released with workflow support.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting the corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select a document template when creating a new object.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Create a pure object cover for uploaded external files or generated documents.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: assign_document_name
evts.description: Include document type abbreviation and consecutive number in the document name by default.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific metadata and control properties of a document.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit document content with the implemented editing client in a local Office component.

evts.name: print_metadata
evts.description: Automatically print certain document metadata in the document using integrated TAG technology.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document after editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_pdf
evts.description: Display the converted current version on the web.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related authorizations for documents.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: Assign participants for the release process in document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_information
evts.description: Add additional information to a document.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add an attachment to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_information
evts.description: Release and publish additional information directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: modify_additional_information
evts.description: Modify additional information.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment for archiving and archive it with release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Start the three-step release process after document creation, maintenance, and control definition.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: Registered author signs the Creator workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewers check the document and complete review tasks.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser completes release and releases the document.

evts.name: reject_review_or_release
evts.description: Reject during review or release, canceling workflow for subsequent participants after the first rejection.

evts.name: send_e_mail_notification
evts.description: Inform users of workflow status, workflow tasks, releases, change proposals, and process information by email.

evts.name: document_electronic_signature
evts.description: Document participants' signatures in the system for each released version.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish the document after release so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid and released document, automatically creating a new version in editing status.

evts.name: create_document_version
evts.description: Create a new document version due to revision, attachment changes, reference change, or scheduled change proposal.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document without affecting content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents the editing of assigned change proposals directly in the change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request 30 days before validity expires.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: Process the request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: declare_additional_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete the request, keep the document valid, and update valid-until date.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process when a revised new version is released.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: Create a request for override for a selected document.

evts.name: start_override_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start workflow after attaching the request for override.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: Process invalidation with releaser or initiator, reviewer, and releaser.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declare the document and attachments invalid, set the last valid approved version out of force, and archive them.

evts.name: revoke_authorization
evts.description: Revoke all rights except archive group rights after override.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start workflow for reactivation.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Creator of the request confirms reactivation.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Create a new version from an invalidated document and restore authorizations and distribution list.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Reactivate attachments archived with the document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain distribution lists for each document by assigning User Groups or persons.

evts.name: distribute_by_e_mail
evts.description: Inform assigned users and users of assigned User Groups by email notification when a new version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Request assigned persons and users of assigned User Groups by email to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement of a document without a signature.

evts.name: summarize_acknowledgement
evts.description: Provide the author team with an overview of unconfirmed acknowledgements and notification when all acknowledgements are confirmed.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Fill user and role-specific dashboards based on distribution groups assigned per document.

evts.name: evaluate_report
evts.description: Evaluate documents or acknowledgements using role-specific reports and searches.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content of the system into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Check the translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release the translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible or not.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client for a local addition.

evts.name: reference_original_document
evts.description: Create a reference from a local document to the original document.
